description: Shadab Textile Mills Limited is a PSX-listed spinner incorporated in 1979, manufacturing blended yarn at its Shahkot plant in District Sheikhupura, Punjab, with a second unit at Habibabad, District Kasur. It produces polyester/cotton (PC) and chief value cotton (CVC) yarns across a range of counts for knitting and weaving customers, and its shares have been quoted on the exchange since 1985. Capacity has grown from 14,400 to 33,600 spindles.
headOffice: A-601, City Towers, 6-K, Main Boulevard Gulberg II, Lahore, Pakistan
